purpose: Machine-readable contract for the T3 nine-case lineage (GAP-LBM-T3-BENCH). The validation matrix judges cases; this file states which physics each slot actually requires, which physics each case exercises, and therefore which slots a passing case may (and may not) credit.
rules: slot_state=verified: every required component has at least one case with status==passed, physics_class in slot.requires.physics_class and no disqualifying credit_caveat.
slot_state=partial: at least one required component is covered, but not all.
slot_state=gap: no required component is covered by a qualifying passing case.
A passing case whose physics_class is not in the slot's requirement is recorded as substitute evidence and never credits the slot.
credit_caveat downgrades a component to 'proxy' (recorded, not counted as full credit).
level_basis=grid|resolution counts as convergence evidence; temporal_split is fit stability only and is reported as a caveat.
